annotations.title: Hyrox Race Split & Station Variance Autopsy

description: Public calculator (NO token needed): post-race or simulation Hyrox diagnostic — compares actual 8x1 km run splits and 8 functional station times against empirical compromised pacing targets and P25-P75 station variance benchmarks to pinpoint exact time leaks.

actual_finish_time.description: Optional official finish time as H:MM:SS.

run_times.description: Optional 8 actual 1 km run splits as MM:SS strings.

standalone_5k_time.description: Standalone open 5 km time as MM:SS (e.g. '22:30').

station_times.description: Optional station split times (MM:SS) keyed by station name (e.g. skierg, sled_push, sled_pull, burpees, row, farmers_carry, lunges, wall_balls).

total_run_time.description: Optional total 8 km running time as MM:SS or H:MM:SS if individual splits are unavailable.

name: hyrox_autopsy
